name: Alleppey Backwaters
description: Experience the serene and picturesque network of lagoons and canals by boat, witnessing lush greenery and traditional village life.

name: Alleppey Beach
description: A tranquil beach with golden sands and a beautiful pier, perfect for sunrise and sunset views.

name: Alleppey Lighthouse
description: An iconic lighthouse offering panoramic views of the Arabian Sea and the town, standing tall since 1862.

name: Ambalapuzha Sri Krishna Temple
description: A historic temple famous for its exquisite architecture and the unique sweet milk porridge called 'Palpayasam'.

name: Krishnapuram Palace
description: A majestic 18th-century palace showcasing traditional Kerala architecture and ancient murals.

name: Pathiramanal Island
description: A small island in Vembanad Lake known for its rich birdlife and peaceful natural surroundings.

name: Marari Beach
description: A pristine and less crowded beach offering a perfect blend of tranquility and traditional fishing village culture.

name: Alleppey Boat House Stay
description: Stay overnight on a traditional houseboat cruising through the backwaters, enjoying local cuisine and scenic views.

name: Mullakkal Rajarajeswari Temple
description: A prominent temple in the heart of Alleppey dedicated to Goddess Rajarajeswari, known for its vibrant festivals.

name: Kuttanad Paddy Fields
description: Explore the vast and unique below-sea-level paddy fields, often called the 'Rice Bowl of Kerala'.

name: St. Mary's Forane Church
description: A beautiful old church with colonial architecture and a peaceful ambiance in the heart of Alleppey.

name: Alleppey Market
description: A bustling local market offering fresh spices, seafood, and handicrafts, perfect for an authentic shopping experience.

name: Vembanad Lake
description: The longest lake in India, offering stunning views, bird watching, and boat rides through its vast waters.

name: Chettikulangara Devi Temple
description: A revered temple known for its grand festivals and traditional Kerala temple architecture.

name: Alleppey Boat Jetty
description: The main boat jetty from where houseboats and ferries depart, bustling with local activity and scenic views.

name: Pathiramanal Bird Sanctuary
description: A hidden gem for bird watchers, this sanctuary hosts migratory and native birds in a peaceful island setting.

name: Alleppey Heritage Museum
description: Showcasing the rich cultural and historical heritage of Alleppey through artifacts, photographs, and exhibits.

name: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary
description: A renowned sanctuary near Alleppey, home to a variety of migratory birds and lush mangrove forests.

name: Alleppey Boat Race (Nehru Trophy Boat Race)
description: Witness the thrilling annual snake boat race, a spectacular cultural event showcasing local traditions and competitive spirit.
